data.name: Daaiyah
data.gender_notes: Daaiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is constantly in search of knowledge and truth. The name Daaiyah carries the meaning “Seeker” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Daaiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody seeker and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who is deeply connected to their faith and is always seeking to learn and grow
data.etymology: Daaiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Seeker.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daaiyah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: داعية
in_arabic.meaning: داعية تعني الداعية إلى الله أو الشخص الذي يدعو الناس إلى الخير
in_arabic.long_meaning: داعية هي اسم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل دعا، والذي يعني الدعوة إلى الله أو إلى الخير. في اللغة العربية، الداعية هو الشخص الذي يدعو الناس إلى الله أو إلى فعل الخير. اسم داعية له أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرتبط بالدعوة إلى الإسلام والتواصل مع الناس لنشر القيم الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: داعیہ
in_urdu.meaning: داعیہ یعنی وہ شخص جو لوگوں کو اللہ کی طرف بلاتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: داعیہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'اللہ کی طرف بلانے والا' یا 'وہ شخص جو لوگوں کو خیر کی طرف دعوت دیتا ہے'۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ دین اسلام کی دعوت اور لوگوں کے ساتھ رابطہ کرنے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے تاکہ اسلامی اقدار کو پھیلایا جا سکے۔

in_hindi.name: दाइयाह
in_hindi.meaning: दाइयाह का अर्थ है जो लोगो को ईश्वर की ओर बुलाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: दाइयाह एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है 'ईश्वर की ओर बुलाने वाला' या 'वह व्यक्ति जो लोगों को अच्छे की ओर आमंत्रित करता है'। इस नाम का इस्लामी संस्कृति में बहुत महत्व है क्योंकि यह इस्लाम की बुलावा और लोगों से जुड़ने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है ताकि इस्लामी मूल्यों को फैलाया जा सके।

in_pashto.name: داعیه
in_pashto.meaning: داعیه یعنی هغه څوک چې خلک د الله طرف ته رابلل
in_pashto.long_meaning: داعیه د عربي ژبې يو نوم دی چې مانا يې ده 'الله ته د بللو په معنا' يا 'هغه څوک چې خلک د خير په لور ته رابلل'. دا نوم په اسلامي کلتور کې ډير اهميت لري ځکه چې دا د اسلام د دعوت او خلکو سره د اړيکې لپاره کارول کيږي تر څو چې اسلامي ارزښتونو ته وده ورکړي.

in_english.name: Daaiyah
in_english.meaning: Daaiyah means one who invites or calls to Allah or good
in_english.long_meaning: The name Daaiyah is derived from the Arabic root 'd-a-w' which means 'to call' or 'to invite'. In Islamic tradition, Daaiyah refers to a person who invites others to Allah or to do good deeds. The name holds significant spiritual meaning, emphasizing the importance of calling others to righteousness and spreading Islamic values. Historically, the term has been used to describe individuals who have played a crucial role in spreading Islam through their preaching and invitations to the faith. The name Daaiyah symbolizes guidance, wisdom, and the pursuit of spiritual growth.

data.cultural_impact: The title "Daaiyah" holds great significance in Islamic culture. It represents an individual who embodies a relentless pursuit of knowledge, understanding, and truth. Daaiyahs are recognized as scholars, teachers, mentors, and spiritual guides within their communities. Their role extends beyond traditional education to encompass a deeper sense of wisdom, compassion, and service to others. These individuals reflect the emphasis on knowledge and education as essential aspects of personal and spiritual development in Islamic teachings, inspiring generations to continue this quest.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the title "Daaiyah" symbolizes a way of life centered on continuous learning andenhancement of one's faith. Spiritually, a Daaiyah is seen as a beacon of wisdom and enlightenment. Through their dedication to the pursuit of knowledge, they seek to illuminate the path towards a deeper understanding of the divine. Guided by patience, humility, and wisdom, Daaiyahs embody the spiritual values of open-mindedness, critical thinking, and self-examination. The title calls upon its bearers to initiate a lifelong journey of growth and transformation, ultimately leading to a closer connection with the Divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Seeker" symbolizes A person who is constantly in search of knowledge and truth. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Daaiyah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of seeker.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Sa'd (d. 845 CE) in his Tabaqat al-Kubra (Book 1, p. 136) mentions a man named Daaiyah ibn Khalaf al-Qurashi who was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).

trends: Daaiyah is a common name in the Arab world.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Daaiyah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
